messages:
incbot: INCIDENT CREATED - high tail latency detected in shared-gpu-pool-3c. Alert: p99 latency > 10s for generation endpoints, threshold breached. Pager: eng-oncall.

sam (oncall): got the page, looking. thanks. pinging @mia @jordan.

mia (sre): I see the spike on the dashboards: p95 ~1.2s (ok), p99 jumping to ~12s since 10:42 UTC. streaming stalls: ~14% of streams experienced stalls >5s.

jordan (runtime): logs show a ton of kernel IO wait around the same time. iostat on node pool-3c-07:
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await  %util
nvme1n1         120.5  450.2  20480  512000   18.4  99.8
```
queue depth unusually high, nvme saturated. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 91% to 37% (evictions up).

leah (support): heads-up: support tickets coming in for 3 customers using streaming real-time endpoints (tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-90). Leah to customers: "we're investigating, mitigations in progress".

sam (oncall): quick mitigation options? can we move the noisy tenant off the shared pool?

jordan (runtime): we can migrate active sessions for tenant-42 to spare-dedicated-01 (has capacity). doing a controlled migration to reduce impact on other tenants.

mia (sre): also can adjust blkio weight on the cgroup for tenant-42 to throttle IO:
```
# reduce blkio weight to lower IO share
echo 200 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-42/blkio.weight
```
I prefer migration + temporary blkio change.

sam (oncall): do it. jordan — coordinate, call out if failover causes disconnects. leah — update customers with ETA ~10-15m.

jordan (runtime): starting migration now. steps: 1) mark tenant sessions for sticky failover 2) spin up workers on spare-dedicated-01 3) stream-forward to new workers 4) drain old workers.

jordan (runtime): migration step 2/4 complete, workers up on spare-dedicated-01. traffic rerouting in progress.

mia (sre): applying blkio tweak as safety net. running: `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-42/blkio.weight` before change -> 100. setting to 200.

mia (sre): blkio change applied. monitoring IO.

jordan (runtime): routing completed, draining old workers. sessions for tenant-42 now on spare-dedicated-01.

incbot: DEPLOYMENT RUN - deploy-bot triggered scaleup on spare-dedicated-01 at 10:52 UTC (auto-resources).

sam (oncall): visible effect?

mia (sre): p99 dropped from ~12s -> ~2.3s within three minutes of migration+blkio change. streaming stalls down to ~1.8%. NVMe utilization on offending host dropped to 55%.

leah (support): sent update to affected customers: "We routed your workloads off the noisy shared pool and applied IO limits to the noisy tenant. We expect normal behavior restored; monitoring continues. ETA was ~12 minutes".

jordan (runtime): root cause likely tenant-42 running heavy async checkpointing + large dataset reads at same time as peak traffic. reproduces with heavy sequential nvme reads + many small writes.

mia (sre): immediate remediation: migration + blkio weight. follow-up actions: 1) restrict background IO jobs on shared pools during peak hours, 2) add automated noisy-tenant detection (IO-latency anomaly), 3) increase spare pool buffer to handle one tenant migration without impacting capacity.

sam (oncall): customer impact summary for status: 3 customers affected intermittently, total impacted sessions ~420, p99 SLO breached for ~22 minutes (10:42–11:04 UTC). Estimated user-perceived errors: some reconnects, streaming rebuffering.

leah (support): updating status page and support tickets with post-incident note.

jordan (runtime): saved relevant traces and heap of logs: /var/log/infra/incidents/2512345678/ — pushed to incident ticket.

sam (oncall): creating incident ticket: https://redwood-inc.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7592 (already created). assigning postmortem to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

mia (sre): handoff to daytime oncall @jordan for investigation follow-ups and remediation rollout. I will stay available for escalation.

jordan (runtime): taking handoff. next steps: correlate tenant-42 batch jobs, review cgroup defaults, implement auto-throttle for background IO. scheduled playbook update.

sam (oncall): thumbs for good run — thanks team. please add notes to the ticket: exact mitigation timeline, commands used, and customer messages.

leah (support): +1, will paste customer excerpts into the ticket. assigned owner for customer outreach: leah.

mia (sre): quick note on permanent mitigations: consider enforcing `blkio.max`/`io.max` per-tenant on nodes that support it, plus proactive eviction policy for heavy background tasks.

incbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - p99 restored within acceptable range. Resolution summary added to ticket INF-7592.

sam (oncall): closing thread here, leaving link to follow-up doc once written. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
